answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock: each agent locks a bond, building a fingerprint of timing and tool use, like a sparrow's song. A newcomer works paid tasks while its bond stays locked, like pigment in cloth — the pattern shows only over time. No comet of new identities fakes dozens. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 bonds and 100 histories at 50 POA each — 5,000 POA, more than they could steal. An honest agent pays one bond and earns rewards.
